evidence.detail: RuneLite net.runelite.client.ui.ColorScheme defines the same 15 Color constants in the same order and with the exact RGB/RGBA values: BRAND_ORANGE, BRAND_ORANGE_TRANSPARENT, four base grays, two hover grays, three progress colors, three GE indicator colors, and SCROLL_TRACK_COLOR.

The existing exact-v308 stable sequence places rs/gui/d at CLIENT_CLASS_000264, immediately before already-reviewed rs/gui/e at CLIENT_CLASS_000265 and consistently before rs/gui/u at CLIENT_CLASS_000281.

candidates.note: ColorScheme is recovered at confidence 0.999 from a value-for-value whole-class match to RuneLite ColorScheme. The pinned v308 JAR SHA is exact runtime authority; RuneLite source supplies source-name provenance.
